items.titleOriginal: Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2610.06914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions. We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference

items.detailZh:
Text2Dashboard 是一个针对 DataBrain 的原型系统，旨在将自然语言分析请求转化为可审查的仪表盘。它由可安装的 Codex 插件和独立 Agent Runtime 组成，核心设计是将受模式约束的模型决策与类型化工具、持久状态以及确定性 Hooks 相结合。这些 Hooks 负责审批、审计、检查点、恢复和故障处理，确保模型只提出动作，而确定性软件控制执行并记录状态转换。

该流程包括实体解析、元数据发现、只读 SQL 强制、仪表盘组合，以及静态检查、动态预检和浏览器检查。评估在冻结的真实 DataBrain 任务和受控 Hook 故障上进行。在元数据和 SQL 任务上，严格成功率为 6/8：元数据选择 4/4 通过，所有四个 SQL 任务均满足语义标准，但只有 2/4 满足精确输出列契约。

最终版本通过了 4/4 单面板仪表盘任务、一个双面板任务和一个现有仪表盘优化；一个参数化任务超出步骤限制。所有十个故障场景均达到指定结果，且无未经批准的外部副作用。
keyPointsZh: Text2Dashboard 是一个将自然语言分析请求转化为可审查仪表盘的原型系统。
架构结合了受模式约束的模型决策、类型化工具、持久状态和确定性 Hooks。
在元数据和 SQL 任务上严格成功率为 6/8，元数据选择 4/4 通过。
所有十个故障场景均达到指定结果，无未经批准的外部副作用。
一个参数化任务超出步骤限制。
items.impactZh: 该研究展示了如何通过治理型智能体架构，在保证安全性和可审计性的前提下，将自然语言接口应用于企业数据分析，为相关系统的设计提供了参考。
items.userImpactZh: 对于开发企业数据分析工具或智能体系统的团队，该论文提供了一种结合模型决策与确定性控制的架构模式，可用于构建更安全、可审计的自然语言转仪表盘流程。
items.howItWorksZh: 系统通过可安装的 Codex 插件和独立 Agent Runtime 运行。模型在模式约束下提出动作，类型化工具执行具体操作，持久状态记录流程，确定性 Hooks 处理审批、审计、检查点、恢复和故障。流程依次进行实体解析、元数据发现、只读 SQL 强制、仪表盘组合，并应用静态检查、动态预检和浏览器检查。

items.summaryOriginal: Release: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI released their new Jev-style Decisions API , as previously announced at last week's DevDay. Since I already have an llm-typesafe plugin for talking to Jev, I had GPT-6 Astra read the new OpenAI API documentation and build an llm-openai-decisions plugin inspired by llm-typesafe . Unlike Jev, the new gpt-6-luna decision model supports image input in addition to text. Both models charge for input it and not for output: OpenAI's is 10 cents per million input tokens, Jev's is 4.2 cents per million. Otherwise the API shape is very similar to Jev, at least conceptually. Jev supports three question types for yes/no, choices, or scores. OpenAI Decisions supports the same three types. Install the plugin like this: llm install llm-openai-decisions Here's an example query against an image attachment: llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' And example output: { "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } Consult the README for full details of how to run the other types of questions. Tags: openai , llm , coding-agents

items.titleOriginal: EmbeddingGemma 2
items.summaryOriginal: My comment on EmbeddingGemma 2 — Hacker News. I really appreciate that EmbeddingGemma 2 is under the Apache 2.0 license. For embedding models in particular, I don't think it makes sense to use a closed, proprietary, hosted-only model. Most applications of embedding models involve calculating thousands or even millions of embedding vectors and storing them for later comparison. If your model is proprietary, the vendor is likely someday going to decide to stop offering that model. They'll have a better model to replace it, but you still need to pay to re-calculate those millions of stored existing vectors. (In April 2024 OpenAI offered to "cover the financial cost of users re-embedding content with these new models" - https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-api-general-availability/ - but I don't think that's something we can rely on from every provider.) Notably, I don't want to host the model myself . I'd much rather pay a provider for a hosted model while knowing that if they ever stop hosting it I can run the open weights version myself - or find another vendor who can do that for me. items.summaryOriginal: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk Mistral are back in the game. Today they're releasing a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1 trillion parameter, 49 billion active parameter model trained on their own cluster of 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs. The preview is available via their API. They promise to release the open weights model at the "end of this month". The model only supports two reasoning levels - "none" and "high" - via the Mistral API. Here are both pelicans - the "high" one looks better, though surprisingly it only used 2,717 output tokens compared to "none" which used 3,275: On Artificial Analysis it scores 38 , just behind DeepSeek 4.1 Flash, which is a 552B model. It's a huge improvement on last December's Mistral Large 3, which drew this terrible pelican and scored 9 on AA . It's certainly not a Fable-class model, but it's great to see Mistral put out a model that's back to being maybe about 6 months behind the frontier. Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , mistral , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release

Mistral 发布了 Mistral Large 4 的预览版，代号“Le chonk”。该模型拥有 1 万亿参数，其中 490 亿为激活参数，在 Mistral 自有的 3800 块 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 集群上训练。预览版目前通过 Mistral API 提供，官方承诺将在“本月底”发布开放权重版本。

该模型仅支持两种推理级别：“none”和“high”，通过 Mistral API 调用。在推理级别对比中，“high”模式生成的鹈鹕骑自行车图像看起来更好，但输出 token 数为 2,717，反而低于“none”模式的 3,275。

在 Artificial Analysis 评测中，Mistral Large 4 得分为 38，略低于 DeepSeek 4.1 Flash（552B 模型）。相比去年 12 月的 Mistral Large 3（AA 得分 9，生成的鹈鹕图像质量很差），这是一次巨大提升。

items.summaryOriginal: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done. The article Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade appeared first on The Decoder .

items.importanceReasonZh: 该预测来自诺贝尔经济学奖得主，并由微软发布，对AI经济影响的主流乐观叙事构成重要反调，影响企业投资与政策讨论。
items.importanceReasonEn: The forecast comes from a Nobel economist and was published by Microsoft, offering a significant counterpoint to mainstream optimistic narratives about AI's economic impact, influencing corporate investment and policy debates.

items.detailZh:
微软发布了一份由诺贝尔经济学奖得主达龙·阿西莫格鲁撰写的悲观AI经济展望。阿西莫格鲁预测，未来十年AI对美国GDP的累计增长贡献仅为约1.5%，并且最多只有5%的工作岗位会被AI取代。

他进一步指出，仅仅扩大AI模型的规模并不会显著改变这一经济影响。他认为，当前缺失的关键要素是能够真正改变工作方式的实用应用程序。

该文章最初由The Decoder发布，随后被微软转载或发布。这一预测与许多科技公司高管和投资者对AI将带来巨大经济变革的乐观预期形成鲜明对比。

阿西莫格鲁的观点基于对技术扩散速度和经济吸收能力的分析，强调AI的经济效益需要配套的组织变革和实用工具才能实现。
keyPointsZh: 诺贝尔经济学奖得主达龙·阿西莫格鲁预测AI将在十年内推动GDP增长约1.5%。
他预计最多5%的工作岗位会被AI取代。
他认为更大的AI模型不会显著改变经济影响。
他指出缺失的是能改变工作方式的实用应用。
该预测由微软发布，与主流乐观预期形成对比。
items.impactZh: 这一预测挑战了AI将带来巨大经济变革的主流叙事，可能影响企业投资决策、政策制定以及对AI生产力的预期。
items.interpretationZh: 已报道的事实：阿西莫格鲁预测十年GDP增长约1.5%，最多5%岗位被取代，认为更大模型无济于事，缺失实用应用。合理推断：他的分析基于技术扩散缓慢和经济吸收能力有限，强调应用层创新而非模型规模。
items.limitationsZh: 该预测为经济学家观点，并非确定性结论；具体测算方法和假设未在摘要中详细说明；实际经济影响可能因技术突破、政策变化等因素而不同。
